shortTitle: Blood Pressure Measurements from Health Kiosks in JAMA Cardiology
longTitle: Blood Pressure Measurements from Self-Service Health Kiosks in US Retail Stores, 2017--2024
summary:
A critical gap in understanding the care continuum of high blood pressure in the United States is the declining survey non-response for NHANES.

As part of a collaboration with Pursuant Health, Thomas Hsiao conducted a comprehensive comparison of estimates of high blood pressure categories from NHANES between 2017-2024 in two-year intervals, with those from self-service health kiosks located in all Walmarts and select CVS stores in the country.

Read more about the collaboration here.

We were also honored to receive an Editorial Comment from Sadiya Khan, Robert A. Harrington, and Faraz S. Ahmad
citation: Hsiao T., Varghese J.S. et.al. Blood Pressure Measurements from Self-Service Health Kiosks in US Retail Stores, 2017 – 2024. JAMA Cardiology. 2025. 10(10). doi:10.1001/jamacardio.2025.2487
